map.由压力与流速求空化数: Find the Cavitation Number from Pressure and Velocity
map.输入当地压力 p、饱和蒸气压 p_v、密度 ρ、流速 v，求空化数。: Enter the local pressure p, saturation vapour pressure p_v, density ρ and velocity v to find the cavitation number.
map.σ 越小越易空化（σ<1 危险）。: A smaller σ means cavitation occurs more easily, with σ<1 dangerous.
map.判泵/螺旋桨空化: Judging cavitation in pumps and propellers
map.σ = (p − pv)/(½·ρ·v²)。pv 为液体饱和蒸汽压；σ 越小越易: σ = (p − pv)/(½·ρ·v²), where pv is the saturation vapour pressure of the liquid; the smaller σ is, the easier cavitation occurs.
map.σ = (p − pv)/(½·ρ·v²)。例：常温清水 pv=2339 Pa、: σ = (p − pv)/(½·ρ·v²). Example: clean water at room temperature with pv=2339 Pa, p=101325 Pa, ρ=1000 kg/m³ and v=10 m/s gives σ=(101325−2339)/(0.5×1000×100)=98986/50000≈1.98; if the critical σ of the blade section is roughly 0.3 to 1, this case has not yet cavitated, and the lower σ is the closer it comes to the cavitation threshold.
map.随几何而变，sigma 低于临界即生成空泡，伴噪声与剥蚀。: It varies with geometry; once sigma falls below the critical value cavities form, bringing noise and surface erosion.
map.空泡溃灭产生局部高压冲击，侵蚀金属表面。: Collapsing cavities generate local high-pressure shocks that erode metal surfaces.
